xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAuditQualificationExp: The Statement includes the Group’s share of net loss of Rs. 60.02 and Rs. 104.40 for the quarter and six-month period ended 30 September 2026, respectively, Rs. 44.38 for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, and Rs. 26.18 and Rs. 52.36 for the quarter and six-month period ended 30 September 2025, respectively, in respect of Mixx Technologies, Inc., an associate of the Group, with a quarter lag, as permitted under Ind AS 28, Investments in Associates and Joint Ventures. However, such financial information has not been reviewed/audited by their auditors and has been furnished to us by the Holding Company’s management. In the absence of review/audit of aforesaid financial information and inability to perform any alternative review procedures thereon to support our conclusion on the Statement, we are unable to comment on any adjustments that may be required to the Group’s share of net loss, including the impact of dilution gain, as included in the Statement in the aforesaid periods, the carrying amount of the investment in the associate as at 30 September 2026, and any other consequential impact thereof on the Statement.
